column5: Current content on alternate official route explicitly says no active recruiting trial within the PetCure national network; empty roster. Preserved separate original master transport failure.
Master links canine mast-cell and feline lymphoma resources. Both resolve to ImpriMed precision profiling; no study with an anticancer intervention or trial intake is identified.

Only oncology item on current index is longstanding artificial-neobladder protocol, matched by procedure/site/Weisse. Three other items are arthritis, cart survey, and CKD. The individual page names referral route and postoperative drainage but lacks an updated 2026 recruitment statement and owner costs. Old protocol stays hidden.

Chinese original lists three specifically recruiting cohorts with histology and contacts. MCT recurrent/unresected, OSA no amputation or lung metastases, oral SCC carrying tumor. Drug and scheduled tumor rechecks free; site-level diagnostics split and date not posted. All three already in canonical; no additional cohort on primary notice.

Primary sponsor page explicitly recruits Australian dogs with mast-cell cancer for personalized mRNA vaccine alongside standard care, through its screening team and treating veterinarian. No osteosarcoma cohort, cutoff, or public exact cost and no fixed study center published on intake page.

Official press index via Web and three native sponsor announcements distinguish US canine HSA post-splenectomy and dose-ranging cats. Both pilots ended recruitment and matching AVMA records VCT24005788/VCT25005865 are Completed; canine legacy entry is already hidden. September dog results announce further development, without opened pivotal registration. Cat dose data do not constitute new enrollment.
Exact Cornell SINE record reconciled and closed VCT24005828. Keep other marketplace candidates open until link-by-link comparison; no new individual access attempt on restricted Anitrial route.

Official named Clinical Trials page explains trials generally and links its clinic/contact routes, without a study title, protocol or recruitment intake. Do not count oncology clinic sites as trials; separate regional discovery is required.

Japanese development track describes finished/in-progress veterinary development and lists primarily cardiopulmonary, endocrine and bladder items. It identifies no therapeutic oncology patient protocol or intake on the published page; no matcher activation.

Master is general entry; Flint listings and structured CSU roster accessible. Compare all fields/identified oncologic entries with exact current and date data, including engineered T-cells and any master/JSON differences; only named five identities preliminarily crosswalked.

Current oncology section names five interventional canine/feline protocols, already canonical; equine and noninterventional cancer-hero signals separate. Master still lists invasive bladder IL-12; reconcile exact direct September cutoff, plus August and December deadlines and changed pages, before updating source roster.

Compare sponsor-approved versus confirmed recruiting sites and parallel sponsored protocols. The CCA reports B7H3 CAR-T enrollment, but old solid-tumor and Jan-2025 metastatic OSA/HSA flyers differ; verify current protocol identity and intake date with institution before matchability.
